body: A can of corn and sealed bandage are wrapped in the same strip of road tape. Yellow field dust is trapped under the tape.
title: Lunch wrapped with a bandage
gloss: Field residue and response material share one everyday bundle.
rival_reading: Field workers or an emergency crew could have bundled these supplies; dust and road tape leave the order of events unresolved.

body: A spoon and a paperclip were caught in a folded feed sack used to line the tray. Its handwritten lot mark predates the closure notice pinned over it.
title: A sack beneath the sandwich tray
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: An emergency team could have moved farm supplies during a containment response.
